stem: A 2-year-old with iron deficiency anaemia drinks about 2 litres of cow milk each day. What is the best initial management?

options.text: Oral iron therapy and reducing cow milk intake to no more than about 500 mL/day
Oral iron therapy without dietary change
No treatment because this is physiological

explanation: Iron deficiency anaemia in toddlers is treated with iron supplementation and dietary change. Excess cow milk intake is a common contributor and should be reduced.
